messages.text: Hi! I want to see everything the session includes
Of course! Your Full Color Analysis includes:

✔️ A 1-on-1, 120-minute session with real color drapes  
✔️ Your exact color combination and why each color works for you  
✔️ Your personalized digital palette on your phone  
✔️ The colors that are best to avoid

🎁 A 3-in-1 guide for clothing, hair color, and makeup  
🎁 Your physical color palette to take shopping  
🎁 14 days of WhatsApp support for your purchases

Are you comparing it with another option?
That sounds great! Is the session in person?
Yes, it’s an in-person 1-on-1 session in Tijuana, with real drapes and natural light. The first step is a free 30-minute diagnostic call with Nat on Google Meet. Are you in Tijuana or San Diego? ✨
I’m in San Diego and cross to Tijuana often. What times are available for the call?
That’s perfect, San Diego is nice and close 😊 For the call, I have Tuesday, October 13 at 9:00 a.m. or 11:00 a.m. Which works better for you?
Tuesday, October 13 at 11:00 a.m. works for me.
Great, Tuesday, October 13 at 11:00 a.m. is available. To book it, please send me your name and WhatsApp number with country code (+1 or +52). ✨
My name is Jessica, and my WhatsApp number is +1 [your number].
Thanks, Jessica! Tuesday, October 13 at 11:00 a.m. is available. The number came through as “+1 [your number]”; could you send your complete WhatsApp number with the country code? ✨
Sure, my complete WhatsApp number is +1 619 555 0147.
You’re all set, Jessica! Your diagnostic call is booked for Tuesday, October 13, 11:00 a.m. on Google Meet. You’ll receive the confirmation and reminders by WhatsApp. It was lovely helping you! ✨
